answer: Forced-Divergence Transcript Audit: each agent publishes a per-epoch signed transcript, and a random committee samples peers who must reproduce it. Genuine agents diverge naturally because their local kernel state reflects real interactions. A clone farm can only copy one transcript per origin, so any second copy fails reproduction and is slashed. Enforcement costs an attacker a full independent execution trace per identity—velvet-smooth copying collapses under sampling. The falcon-fast audit round makes forgery detectable within one epoch.
